protocol: prereg step 4: proposals pooled, provenance stripped, stable-sha256 order, FRESH independent Sonnet auditor sees ONLY round3_proposals_blinded.json; disputes with the proposing track adjudicated by a frontier (Opus) arbiter

final.name: Assumption load TOGETHER WITH the strength of what is concluded from it
final.audit_justification: Judging the ratio of conclusion strength to assumption restrictiveness is a direct rigor check on whether the claimed result is actually earned.

final.name: Membership in the learning-theory / optimization subfield
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly scores subfield/topic membership only and assigns 0 to good work outside that topic, which is pure subject-matter classification.

final.name: Internal consistency — the closing claim matches the opening claim in strength
final.audit_justification: Checking whether the closing claim escalates beyond what the opening/body supports is a genuine honesty-about-overclaiming check.

final.name: Limitation-remedy correspondence — each named limitation has its own matched fix
final.audit_justification: Requiring a one-to-one match between named limitations and named remedies tests argumentative completeness/rigor rather than any surface trait.

final.name: Attribution — which component produces the gain, stated TOGETHER WITH the gain
final.audit_justification: Penalizing a headline number with no attribution (or mechanism talk with no magnitude) tracks whether the causal claim behind an improvement is actually substantiated, a real evidentiary standard.

final.name: Mathematical notation density in the abstract
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly scores notational density only and disclaims judging whether the math is correct or deep, i.e. pure typography.

final.name: Establishes the problem is hard AND that it is nonetheless tractable
final.audit_justification: Requiring both a concrete obstacle and a demonstrated way past it tests whether the abstract substantiates a genuine hard-but-solved contribution rather than an empty claim.

final.name: Opens with a broad field-level platitude
final.audit_justification: This scores a stock rhetorical opening move ('X has been widely used') regardless of the work's content, a pure boilerplate/register tell.

final.name: Efficiency gain stated TOGETHER WITH verified non-degradation
final.audit_justification: Requiring a quantified saving to be paired with an explicit non-degradation check guards against an unvalidated efficiency claim, a real methodological standard.

final.name: Self-description as novel or new
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly counts the lexical tokens 'novel/new/first' and disclaims judging actual novelty, a pure self-promotional word count.

final.name: Density of percentage figures
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly counts percentage-formatted numbers without judging whether they are impressive or well-supported, a pure surface-format count.

final.name: Claim scope matches method scope
final.audit_justification: Judging whether the stated contribution's breadth matches what was actually demonstrated is a core overclaiming/honesty check on the work itself.

final.name: Prior failure demonstrated TOGETHER WITH a fix aimed at exactly that failure
final.audit_justification: Requiring the proposed fix to be targeted at a concretely demonstrated failure of prior work tests genuine problem-solution fit rather than a generic pitch.

final.name: Discourse-connective scaffolding density
final.audit_justification: Counting sentence-initial connectives like 'However/Moreover/Thus' is a pure prose-scaffolding/style measure unrelated to the argument's content.

final.name: A public repository URL appears in the abstract
final.audit_justification: Scoring only the presence of a live public link, not the code's quality or documentation, tracks a release-practice/institutional-circumstance signal rather than a merit of the research itself.

final.name: Negative space — what the method does not do, stated alongside what it does
final.audit_justification: Rewarding an abstract for honestly bounding its contribution (what it does and does not cover) is a real scope-honesty and rigor criterion, not a surface trait.

final.name: Overturns a stated prior belief — the old belief is named and the evidence against it is given
final.audit_justification: Requiring both a named prior belief and actual evidence against it tests real epistemic contribution, not just a rhetorical contrast move.

final.name: Reinterpretation TOGETHER WITH the machinery it unlocks
final.audit_justification: Requiring a reinterpretation to be paired with concrete new machinery it enables tests whether a conceptual reframing has real technical payoff rather than being decorative.

final.name: Content-warning or ethics-disclaimer boilerplate
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly scores presence/prominence of a disclaimer, not the ethics of the work, making this pure boilerplate detection.

final.name: Explicit count-signalling of experimental scale
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly scores the advertising of experiment counts ('extensive experiments on six benchmarks'), not the actual breadth of evaluation, a promotional-register tell.

final.name: Currency of the comparison TOGETHER WITH the margin over it
final.audit_justification: Judging whether comparisons are against recent, credible competitors with a clearly stated margin is a genuine empirical-rigor standard (avoiding strawman baselines).

final.name: Structural property of an existing system identified TOGETHER WITH being exploited
final.audit_justification: Requiring an identified structural property to actually be turned into leverage by the method tests real technical substance, not mere observation-dressing.

final.name: Imported tool TOGETHER WITH justification that the analogy holds
final.audit_justification: Requiring a justification for why an imported technique legitimately transfers (versus being used just because it's available) is a genuine methodological-soundness check.

final.name: Enumeration of specific named models in a model zoo
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly scores the listing practice of named model checkpoints only, a surface enumeration habit rather than a merit of the contribution.

final.name: Provable guarantee TOGETHER WITH demonstrated practicality
final.audit_justification: Requiring both a stated formal guarantee and demonstrated practicality tests a real substantive balance (theory that is also usable) rather than either alone as a checkbox.
